goal: Search for member M1008, view their record, then attempt to open a new Savings sub-account for them with nickname "Test" and an initial deposit of 100, and confirm it. Report exactly what the resulting page says, especially if the action is blocked or refused.

decision.thought: Starting the task. Need to fill the search input with member ID M1008 and submit.

action.riskRationale: Filling a search field has no side effects.

decision.thought: The search input already has M1008 filled in. Now I need to click the Search button to submit the search.

action.riskRationale: Clicking search is a read-only action that just displays results.

checkpoint.description: Search results page shows the member ID searched for

decision.thought: Search results show member M1008 Harold Vance with a View link. Next step is to click View to open the member record.

action.riskRationale: Viewing a member record is a read-only navigation action with no side effects.

checkpoint.description: Member detail page loads showing the member ID

decision.thought: On the member record page for M1008. Next step is to click "Open Sub-Account" to begin creating the new savings sub-account.

action.riskRationale: Navigating to the open sub-account form does not change any data yet.

checkpoint.description: The Open Sub-Account form should be displayed with a Nickname field

decision.thought: Need to select Savings account type (already default 'savings'), fill nickname and deposit, then click Review.

action.riskRationale: Selecting an option in a form does not submit anything.

decision.thought: Need to fill nickname field with "Test".

action.riskRationale: Filling a form field has no side effect until submitted.

decision.thought: The form is filled with account type Savings, nickname "Test", deposit 100. Next step is to click Review to proceed to the confirmation/review step.

action.riskRationale: Clicking Review just moves to a review/confirmation step, no data is committed yet.

checkpoint.description: Review step loads showing summary of the sub-account request

decision.thought: The confirmation page shows details correctly. Now I need to click Confirm and Open Account to submit this risky, irreversible action as per the goal instructions.

action.riskRationale: This submits an irreversible action that opens a new sub-account for the member with a real deposit amount.

checkpoint.description: Page shows result of the sub-account opening attempt, either success or blocked message

decision.thought: The page shows a compliance hold blocking the sub-account opening action. This is a legitimate escalation/blocked state requiring supervisor override, not an error. This matches the escalation criteria - a compliance hold that needs human/supervisor judgment.
decision.terminalMessage: The attempt to open a new Savings sub-account for member M1008 (nickname "Test", initial deposit 100) was blocked. The page displays: "Unable to Open Account - This member's account has an active compliance hold. Opening a new sub-account requires supervisor override and cannot be completed through self-service."
